definitions.explanation: One of the teeth at the back of the mouth, used for grinding food. The everyday word; dentists say {臼歯|きゅうし}. The front teeth are {前歯|まえば}.

examples.japanese: {奥歯|おくば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
⟦{悔|くや}しくて→悔しい：02343_kuyashii⟧{奥歯|おくば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かみしめた。
examples.english: I clenched my teeth in frustration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{奥歯|おくば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{挟|はさ}まった→挟まる：04668_hasamaru⟧ような⟦{言|い}い{方|かた}→言い方：14165_iikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He spoke evasively, as if holding something back.

notes:
⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧ (back, inner part) + ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧ (tooth), voiced to ば.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {奥歯|おくば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かみしめる: to clench one's teeth (enduring pain, anger or frustration)
- {奥歯|おくば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{挟|はさ}まった→挟まる：04668_hasamaru⟧よう: evasive, not saying things straight out (literally "as if something were stuck between the back teeth")
- {奥歯|おくば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{虫歯|むしば}→虫歯：00299_mushiba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to get a cavity in a back tooth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前歯|まえば}→前歯：32246_maeba⟧: front tooth
- ⟦{親知|おやし}らず→親知らず：23503_oyashirazu⟧: wisdom tooth, the rearmost back tooth
